title: Jetzt Sparpreis sichern / Word sequence

location.series: DB new design / original GIF demonstrations

slide_intent: Give short words their own beats because a brief moving message must be read in time.
strategic_value: A three-word offer followed by the red DB mark can connect the promotion to its sender.
demonstration: JETZT, SPARPREIS and SICHERN appear in succession on white, then yield to the red DB logo.
practical_value: Test a short call to action as a paced word sequence before adding photographic content.

content_islands.name: Word and signature sequence
content_islands.spec: Center one black word at a time, then replace it with the smaller red logo.

reference_purposes.Expression: The film sequences wide black words and finishes on the red DB signature.
